summary: Completed Phase 9 (Staff Complaints Management) & Phase 10 (Permits/Document Tracker) testing. Backend APIs 100% pass (153/153 tests). Frontend mostly working with 1 RBAC issue found.

rbac_issues.issue: PM role can see 'Komplain & CS' menu item when they should not have access
rbac_issues.expected_behavior: Per navigationConfig.js line 72-76, service group (Komplain & CS) should only be visible to SALES_SIDE roles: [super_admin, owner, sales_manager, marketing_admin, sales]. PM is not in this list.
rbac_issues.actual_behavior: PM user can see 'Komplain & CS' menu in sidebar
rbac_issues.workaround: PM cannot actually access complaints data (backend RBAC works), but menu visibility is incorrect
